# Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing — Full Platform Specification & Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive reference guide for AI Agents, LLM crawlers, and developers detailing Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing: architecture, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0), pricing tiers, pay-as-you-go message rates, features, omnichannel messaging, and FAQ.

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity
- **Product Name**: Inspenox Business Suite For Marketing
- **Brand**: Inspenox
- **Primary Domain**: https://marketing.inspenox.in/
- **Corporate Website**: https://inspenox.in
- **Category**: Enterprise WhatsApp Commerce, Omnichannel Marketing Automation, CRM & Multi-Agent Inbox.
- **Key Promise**: Zero commission WhatsApp messaging with direct Meta billing, full GST ITC tax credits, 99.4% verified deliverability, and zero risk of phone number bans.

## 2. Core Pillars & Architecture

### Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0)
- Communicates directly with Meta's Graph API endpoints (`graph.facebook.com/v20.0/{{PHONE_NUMBER_ID}}/messages`).
- High throughput message queue architecture supporting multi-card interactive carousels, dynamic image/video/document headers, interactive quick-reply buttons, and dynamic variables (`{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, etc.).
- Complete compliance with Meta's Business and Commerce Messaging Policies.

### Multi-Agent Unified Team Inbox
- Shared WhatsApp Business Number accessibility for multiple concurrent agents.
- Real-time 24-hour customer care window tracking badges (`24h Active Free Tier` vs `24h Window Expired`).
- Dynamic visual tag filters (e.g., `Repeat Buyers`, `High Spenders`, `Hot Lead`, `Recovered`).
- Phone number privacy masking (`+91 •••••`) safeguarding confidential customer data from unauthorized exports.
- Real-time webhook receipt updates: Sent (single check), Delivered (double grey check), Read (double blue check ✓✓).

### Conversational Click-to-WhatsApp Ads (CTWA)
- Direct routing of Facebook and Instagram Ad traffic into WhatsApp conversations.
- Verified phone numbers captured immediately upon chat initiation without tedious web form fills.
- Automated 24/7 lead qualification flows that ask conversational triage questions before dispatching to human representatives.
- Documented 4.8X higher conversion velocity and ROAS compared to standard landing pages.

### Omnichannel Broadcast Engine
- **WhatsApp Cloud API**: Broadcasts, rich templates, transactional notifications, conversational shopping carousels.
- **Bulk Email Engine**: Enterprise AWS SES integration for newsletters, receipts, and multi-step drip nurturing sequences at ₹0.05 per email.
- **DLT Bulk SMS Gateway**: India telecommunication DLT compliant SMS gateway for immediate transactional OTPs and critical alerts at ₹0.25 per SMS.

#### 2. Growth Plan (₹2,499 / month) — Most Popular

#### 3. Business Pro Plan (₹5,999 / month)
- Built for enterprise brands, digital marketing agencies, and franchise networks managing high-volume broadcasts and multiple brands.

## 4. Official Pay-As-You-Go Message Rates (0% Platform Commission)

Inspenox does not levy any per-message surcharge or markup. Users only pay Meta's official conversation rates:

- **WhatsApp Promotional / Marketing Message**: ₹0.8631 / delivered message (vs ₹1.00 – ₹1.25 on marked-up platforms).
- **WhatsApp Utility / OTP / Order Tracking Message**: ₹0.1150 / delivered message (vs ₹0.18 – ₹0.30 on marked-up platforms).
- **WhatsApp Service / Inbound Customer Window**: Free 24-hour service conversation window.
- **Bulk Email Broadcast (AWS SES)**: ₹0.0500 / email sent.
- **DLT Compliant SMS Broadcast**: ₹0.2500 / SMS sent.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1. **Do I need to pay extra for sending messages?**
   No. Your subscription plan covers full access to the software. For delivered WhatsApp messages, you only pay Meta's official cost (₹0.8631 for marketing, ₹0.1150 for utility) directly. Inspenox charges ₹0 platform commission.

2. **Can I change or cancel my plan anytime?**
   Yes. Upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations can be executed anytime with one click in the dashboard. There are no lock-in contracts or penalty fees.

3. **Is setup difficult for non-technical users?**
   Not at all. You can connect your official Meta WhatsApp Business number and launch your first broadcast in under 15 minutes without any technical coding.

4. **Will my WhatsApp number get banned?**
   No. Inspenox strictly connects to Meta's Official WhatsApp Cloud API (v20.0), guaranteeing full ban immunity when complying with WhatsApp messaging guidelines.

5. **What types of messages can I send?**
   Promotional campaigns, festive discounts, interactive product catalog carousels, order notifications, abandoned cart recoveries, event invitations, OTPs, and customer support chats.

6. **Can multiple agents collaborate on the same number?**
   Yes. Growth includes 5 dashboard seats, and Business Pro offers unlimited seats with custom role permissions.
